stock.description: Vistar Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, supplying electrical and mechanical (E&M) engineering solutions throughout Hong Kong. Its business activities are segmented into three primary divisions: Installation Services, Alteration and Addition Works, and Maintenance Services. The firm's core expertise lies in the full lifecycle of fire service systems, encompassing their installation, modification, expansion, and ongoing upkeep. Established in 2017, its corporate base is located in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.
